Suggested use
Shake well before use. Remove cap and fully depress syringe. Insert syringe tip into the middle of the self-sealing adapter until the barrel is flush with the adapter. Invert bottle, keeping the syringe inserted and draw the desired dosage. 4-12 months: Fill syringe to I mL line, daily. 1-3 years: Fill syringe to 0.5 mL line, daily. Dispense liquid slowly towards inner cheek of child's mouth. Hand wash and air dry syringe thoroughly after each use.

Warnings
Accidental overdose of iron-containing products is a leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under 6. Keep this product out of reach of children. In case of accidental overdose, call a doctor or poison control center immediately.

Turn tube upside down.
